title: Fuel — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21).

items.title: Surface /fuel renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /fuel registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping FuelTabRoute tabId=home → FuelPlannerHomePage → FuelHomePage; FuelPlannerHomePage and FuelHomePage both guard against missing operating company with honest empty state; FuelHomePage fetches /api/v1/fuel/planner/dashboard and /api/v1/fuel/loves-sync/status with operating_company_id; fraud and overage KPI cards fetch entity-scoped summaries; dashboard errors use ListErrorBanner with retry; all queries enabled only when companyId is present.

items.title: Surface /fuel/compliance renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /fuel/compliance registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping FuelTabRoute tabId=compliance → FuelPlannerHomePage; FuelPlannerHomePage guards missing operating company; compliance tab fetches /api/v1/fuel/compliance-summary via getFuelComplianceSummary(companyId) and now surfaces ListErrorBanner on query error with retry; CompliancePanel renders real entity-scoped summary data.

items.title: Surface /fuel/expense-mapping renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /fuel/expense-mapping registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping FuelTabRoute tabId=expense_mapping → FuelPlannerHomePage; FuelPlannerHomePage guards missing operating company; expense_mapping tab renders FuelGlMappingCoverage which fetches /api/v1/accounting/expense-category-mappings with operating_company_id and category_kind=fuel; component now surfaces ListErrorBanner on query error with retry, plus loading and honest empty/unmapped states; a direct link to the accounting expense category map is provided.

items.title: Surface /fuel/fraud-alerts renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: NOT YET VERIFIED. Surface enumerated from the route manifest on 2026-07-29. To reach PASS this route must be opened in the running app and shown to render real entity-scoped data (TRANSP and USMCA), every rendered field present in the submit payload where it writes, and forward/reverse linkage proven. No claim is made here beyond the route existing.
